fn: Plan map: new Combined label. One box per hole with the hole number, rig, drilled / planned depth and a thin progress bar, with a left edge in the status colour (green ongoing, blue terminated, amber standby). It sits beside the collar and a thin line connects it when it has to move away. Turn it on or off with the Combined label chip next to Collars only.
ds: Plan map: new Combined label (hole number, rig, drilled / planned depth and progress bar in one box beside the collar, status colour on the left edge). Switch in the Callouts panel: Combined hole label. On by default; switch it off to get the separate depth pill at the hole end back.
